script_text: Stop, Aquarius—the stars are demanding a reality check right now. As an Air sign ruled by Uranus, you feel the static before anyone else names it. The Sun in your 11th House is squaring Neptune in your 3rd House, blurring group loyalties and clever ideas. Pluto in your 1st House keeps reshaping your identity, so stop performing certainty. Taken, avoid vague promises made through friends; speak your needs in plain language. Single, your magnetic honesty now attracts someone unconventional who values real freedom over flattery. In career, Saturn in your 3rd House demands sharper contracts and clearer travel plans; verify every invoice twice, delay big purchases, and post nothing impulsive before midnight. Your words can open doors, so choose them carefully. Avoid lending cash today; instead, accept the unexpected gift of a mentor's blunt review. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
